Today, we are launching Depost AI 2.0. Your AI content team for LinkedIn. I have been waiting a long time to write this. The last few months were intense. We rebuilt major parts of Depost, changed the architecture, reworked the experience, and kept asking ourselves the same question: What should a real LinkedIn content system do beyond writing posts? That question shaped Depost AI 2.0. We built it for B2B founders, marketing teams, and agencies managing multiple brands. Now Depost AI can: - Analyze your LinkedIn analytics and show what is working - Build persistent brand memory around your voice, ICP, positioning, and strategy - Find content gaps and relevant high performing patterns - Generate ideas from your actual brand context - Create posts and matching visuals - Manage reviews, [...] - Create posts and matching visuals - Manage reviews, approvals, teams, and scheduling - Keep every client and brand completely separate - Connect through MCP with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other supported AI tools But the bigger vision is simple: Depost AI should understand your brand before it creates anything for it. Writing is easy now. Knowing what to say, what will matter to your audience, and how to stay consistent every week is harder. That is the problem we spent the last few months solving. And today, we finally get to share it. Depost AI 2.0 is live. Try it at depost.ai Would love to hear what you think after using it. [...] Depost AI
